name: Maulana Qasim Nanautavi
role: Founder figure of Darul Uloom Deoband
contribution: He helped found Darul Uloom Deoband, creating an institutional model that shaped South Asian Islamic scholarship.
context: After the 1857 revolt, Deoband emerged as a major scholarly response to colonial rule and Muslim educational crisis.
impact: Deobandi scholarship later became influential in Bengal's madrasa and ulama networks.
highlight: A founder of the Deoband tradition that later shaped Bengali Muslim scholarship.
